title: ARISTOS part features
description: Holes, pegs and rotational symmetries of part types, authored by contributors. Geometry is in the part model's own frame (GLB node origin), Y up, millimetres.

model.description: Model uuid (PartTypes.model), with or without hyphens; alternative to partType

uuid.description: Stable id; generated on import if absent

name.description: Unique within the part type, e.g. H1 / shaft / mount_A

center.description: mm, model frame: a point on the cylinder axis, at the middle of the feature's extent

axis.description: Direction of the cylinder axis (normalised on import). Hole: bottom -> mouth. Peg: root -> tip

depth.description: mm, extent of the cylindrical surface along the axis

center.description: mm, model frame: a point on the axis

degrees.description: Rotating the part by this angle about the axis maps it onto itself (180 = can be flipped; 72 = 5-fold)
